question: The process of removing silica from soil is known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**desilication**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 
**Desilication:**

 
 
• Desilication is the specific process of removing silica (silicon dioxide) from soil or other materials.
 
• This process is often relevant in soil science, particularly in the formation of laterite soils.
 
• It involves the chemical weathering and removal of silica, typically in alkaline environments.
 
• The process can be accelerated by high rainfall and warm temperatures.
 
• It is a key process in the formation of some types of clay minerals.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
**Salinisation:**

 
 
• Salinisation is the process of increasing the salt content of soil or water.
 
• It is often caused by irrigation practices, particularly in arid and semi-arid regions.
 
• Excessive salt accumulation can harm plant growth and soil fertility.
 
• It is a major environmental issue in many parts of the world.
 
• Salinisation can lead to desertification.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Polarisation:**

 
 
• Polarisation is a term used in various scientific contexts, including physics and social sciences.
 
• In physics, it refers to the restriction of the vibrations of a transverse wave to one direction.
 
• In social sciences, it refers to the division of a population into opposing groups.
 
• It has no direct relevance to the removal of silica from soil.
 
• It is a process that has many different meanings depending on the subject that it is used within.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Leaching:**

 
 
• Leaching is the process of removing soluble constituents from a solid by percolating liquid through it.
 
• While leaching can remove various substances from soil, including silica, it is a broader term than desilication.
 
• Leaching is a general process, and desilication is a more specific type of leaching.
 
• Leaching can remove many minerals, and not just silica.
 
• Leaching is a common process in areas with high rain fall.
